name: kalvium-dojo-enhancer
description: Kalvium DOJO Enhancer — Dark mode, custom themes/backgrounds, editor colors, live leaderboard, streaks & daily goals. Lightweight browser extension for comfortable long coding sessions. Made by students, for students. Not an official Kalvium extension.

paragraphs: A browser extension that upgrades the Kalvium DOJO coding platform: instant dark mode, focus modes, custom backgrounds, AI-powered problem naming, a floating YouTube popup player, solved-problem GitHub auto-sync, a class leaderboard, goals & streaks, and a one-click contributor survey.
Disclaimer: This is a personal, unofficial tool made by students for students. It is not an official Kalvium product.
features: Dark mode — full-site dark theme toggle (popup + settings), dark mode for the whole Kalvium website.
Modes — designed by Hamza Shaikh: focus, calm, and other study modes that restyle DOJO.
Backgrounds — solid colors, gradient themes, uploaded images, or ambient video.
AI problem naming — auto-renames generic problems with smart titles via Groq (shared key built in), SambaNova, or NVIDIA.

GitHub auto-sync — every solved problem is saved as a Markdown file (statement + your code) under Solved Problems/ in your own kalvium-solutions repository. Connect once — no repo name needed, the repo is created for…
